nrcan_ceud_transport_provincial: Provincial transport energy, activity and fleet statistics by vehicle class; aggregate series do not identify individual vehicle vintages or technologies.
  - 30: Provincial inter-city-bus passenger activity and energy use by fuel; fuel activity shares are inferred separately.
  - 31: Provincial school, transit and inter-city bus stock and distance travelled; fuel-specific fleet counts are not reported.
nlr_atb_transportation: U.S. road-vehicle technology trajectories and operating assumptions by class and powertrain; Canadian fleet weighting and service conversion are applied separately.
  - vehicles: U.S. vehicle technology and retail-equivalent price trajectories in 2022 USD; MHDV gasoline/CNG variants are absent, requiring mapped proxies. Manufacturing-cost conversion is applied separately.
epri_us_regen_transportation: U.S. modeled transport technology cost and efficiency assumptions; relative changes and technology coverage are specific to the registered component.
  - intercity_bus_charts: Intercity-bus purchase-price and fuel-economy trajectories; purchase costs use the reviewed 2023 USD basis.
argonne_rd_greet: Fuel-property and process-model evidence from R&D GREET; the registered components distinguish heating values, marine intensity and vehicle-cycle results.
  - fuel_heating_values: Gasoline and diesel higher heating values referenced by configured conversion constants; native units are Btu per U.S. gallon.

Geography is chosen for the whole source-period/broad-powertrain pool before matching. Eligibility and demonstrator exceptions limit market representation; public records lack VIN/transaction IDs, so identical rows are retained without claiming unique vehicles. Request year differs from model year. Unresolved matches use distinct-model catalogue medians; incentive composition does not measure historical sales or in-use consumption.

statcan_transport_tables: Canadian vehicle registrations, freight flows and reported transit-asset useful lives; coverage and statistical concepts differ by table.
